comments.content: Wrapped code literals bypass detection: `result.reason === ('MarkMissing' as const)` and `case ('NotClosed'):` produce wrapper nodes rather than string-literal nodes, so neither is reported. The former was detected by the previous comparison regex. Unwrap parentheses, assertions, non-null and satisfies expressions before classifying code operands, and add regression tests for wrapped comparisons and case expressions.

Phrase matching still uses source spelling rather than decoded literal text. For example, `const label = 'Mark\u0020missing';` renders the prohibited phrase but produces no hit, while escaped whole-value REASON_WORDS are checked using `node.text`. Match decoded content for strings and template fragments as well, preserving a mapping to source offsets for accurate line reporting.
